verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a self-serve sandbox, fully separate from production, that covers all products in the web app and API except Connected Account APIs. It has per-product simulation docs (payments, payouts, deposits, issuing, risk) and an end-to-end payment quickstart run in sandbox, and the CLI and Developer MCP can create test resources and simulate events. The evidence never mentions test card numbers or scenario-specific simulation of declines and disputes, and parity with production is limited by the Connected Account exclusion. Missing for 10: documented test cards for decline/3DS/error scenarios, documented dispute/chargeback simulation in sandbox, full production parity (Connected Account APIs excluded), independent hands-on corroboration.
